title: Verified Self-Training in a Small Language Model: A Prespecified Case Study on GSM-Symbolic (paper, code and results)
description: Paper (preprint, not peer-reviewed), code, dated decision rules and aggregate results for a single-round verified self-training study with LoRA on Qwen3-1.7B-Base. None of the four sequentially prespecified primary tests met its criterion; the intended human-reference positive control also failed to show improvement. GSM-Symbolic question text (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) and adapter weights are not included.
